financial_package.note: Pay Level S-14 under Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2019 (Maharashtra 7th Pay Commission).
financial_package.pay_source_label: Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2019, Government Resolution No. RPS-2019/CR-1/Services-9
financial_package.estimate_note: Basic pay ₹38,600 in Level S-14 (₹38,600 - ₹1,22,800). Gross range computed with 58% DA (₹22,388) and HRA from 9% (Z-class cities) to 27% (X-class cities like Mumbai/Pune), plus police uniform and conveyance allowance, minus standard 10% NPS and state insurance deductions.
official_perks: Government accommodation or House Rent Allowance (HRA up to 27% in metro regions)
Police uniform and kit maintenance allowance
Special duty and investigation conveyance allowance
Medical facilities under Maharashtra State Government Employees Health Scheme
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and 30 days annual earned leave
Subsidized police canteen and welfare association benefits

competition_benchmarks.note: Vacancies for PSI are notified as part of the MPSC Maharashtra Non-Gazetted Group-B Services Combined Examination.
